error[ZBX-E0560]: there are no Google credentials to pull from this registry
  cause  no Google credentials were found to pull from us-docker.pkg.dev
  fix    point GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS at a workload identity federation file
         or pull on Google Compute Engine with a service account
  more   zbx explain E0560 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0560.html
